events.brand: NYS Daniel’s Law Coalition × Assemblymember Catalina Cruz
events.what_it_is: A free community wellness and resource day bringing together NYC organizations offering healthcare and mental-health resources, housing and food assistance, employment and education opportunities, legal services, holistic wellness resources, entertainment, and family activities.
events.what_is_free: Admission and the community wellness/resource programming are free and open to the public.
events.caveats: Published sources describe the event as free and open to the public and also provide a registration link. No organizer-selection or approval step is stated, so this is classified as Free RSVP rather than Approval Required.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–2 PM. Use the playground entrance at 42nd Ave. & 104th St. CIDNY independently lists the same date, hours, location and RSVP path; NAMI Queens/Nassau provides a registration action.

occurrences.details: Free community wellness/resource event at PS 16Q in Corona. Registration link is published; sources also describe the event as free and open to the public.
